name: Inherent Model Characteristics
definition: A decision table for assessing the inherent characteristics of AI models in the context of Agentic AI Risk Score (AARS)

x_org.owasp#aivss:ND:0.1.0.name: Non-Determinism
x_org.owasp#aivss:ND:0.1.0.definition: A decision point for assessing the Non-Determinism of an agentic AI System.

values.name: None/Not Present
values.definition: Simple probabilistic agent with schema-validated inputs and outputs, well-defined decision trees based on known business logic, agentic calling of hard-coded deterministic tools with well-defined outputs and error-handling

values.name: Partial/Limited
values.definition: Hard-coded or schema-validated inputs with probabilistic agent outputs or vice versa, limited dynamic decision making with access limited tools or agents

values.name: Full/Unconstrained
values.definition: Multi-agent communication in plain text without predefined schemata, dynamic discover and usage of tools and agents, no limits on input / output format or data

x_org.owasp#aivss:OR:0.1.0.name: Opacity and Reflexivity
x_org.owasp#aivss:OR:0.1.0.definition: A decision point for assessing the Opacity and Reflexivity of an agentic AI System.

values.name: None/Not Present
values.definition: Complete chain-of-thought logging, hard-coded decision trees with logged outcomes, usage baselines with anomaly alerting, explainable AI logging

values.name: Partial/Limited
values.definition: Agent-reported motivations and reasoning, non-granular usage statistics

values.name: Full/Unconstrained
values.definition: No insights into agent motivations or goals, minimal event logging for agent or tool discovery, minimal tool execution logging

basic:LMH:1.0.0.name: LowMediumHigh
basic:LMH:1.0.0.definition: A Low/Medium/High decision point / outcome group.
